detail:
Decisions: Chose to land the validator as a standalone module commit BEFORE the dispatch/index.ts wiring (plan order Task 4 then Task 3) rather than the plan's Task 3-first order with a throwaway validate-records stub — every commit builds and boots, no stub to delete, and the plan itself names 'do Task 4 before building' as the sanctioned alternative; the README/UPGRADE docs ride the wiring commit because that is when the command becomes invocable; Chose a read-only validator whose exit code fails only on record-file findings and tracked *.tmp / twining.db* (frozen v1 aggregates tracked on a sqlite-era store are informational) — untracking those aggregates is only safe once EVERY host serving the store runs Node >= 22.13 (a files-fallback host needs decisions/index.json), so the tool must not push operators toward it; the validator never writes and runs under TWINING_DISABLED so cron/launchd preflights are safe
Findings: validate-records conflict-marker regex is anchored at line start with the m flag: a CRLF file still trips on its '<<<<<<< ' line, a BOM only hides a marker on line 1 — the pre-tag review lens (a) is asked to probe both
summary: 2.16.1 Task 4 (module): validateRecordsTree + runValidateRecordsCli in src/cli/validate-records.ts — read-only records-mirror preflight; index.ts wiring lands with the Task 3 dispatch commit
